name: Nemo Stats: Weapons MG
description:
Tunes the machine guns' spread, damage, and magazine reloads.

- M-105 Stalwart
  Scope swap: the raw write replaces the default Optics optionId with the
  COMBAT SCOPE 4x; the game's own delta then applies the scope's zoom,
  zeroing, model and crosshair.
- MG-43 Machine Gun
  Scope swap: the raw write replaces the default Optics optionId (TUBE
  REDDOT 1.5x) with the SNIPER SCOPE 10x; the game's own delta then applies
  the scope's zoom, zeroing, model and crosshair.
- M-1000 Maxigun
- MG-206 Heavy Machine Gun
